name: SLICK
text: Fold the junk. It isn't advice. It's arithmetic.

name: SLICK
text: Near the money, play the money.

name: BIO
text: Kid. Stop looking at me. Look at your cards.

name: NICK
text: Welcome back to the feature table. Forty thousand people are watching you blink.

name: MUSTICH
text: Your table or mine, I'll see you at the end of it.

name: TOMMY
text: This room eats dreamers for breakfast.

name: YOU
text: People insist on calling it luck.
